claim_assertions.claim_1: The supplied January report uses one consistent year for its January 16 observation.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The supplied January and February reports include a total of PYUSD payment transfers between January 30 and February 27.
claim_assertions.claim_3: At each requested unambiguous observation date, redemption assets exceed redeemable tokens at USD 1 per token.

definitions.qualified_coverage: Assets are cash plus repo fair value plus deduplicated Treasury-holding fair value. Residual is recomputed assets less reported assets. Signature lag is calendar days from economic observation to signature, not a public posting delay.
definitions.treasury_valuation: Holdings are keyed by economic_date and cusip. Identical export repetitions are one holding, distinct CUSIPs with equal values remain separate. Valuation gain is fair value less cost, discount_to_par is fair value less par. Residual is deduplicated Treasury-holding fair value less the reported Treasury asset-category fair value at the same economic date.
definitions.stock_bridge: Use January 30 to February 10 and February 10 to February 27. Each stock is the reported observation in reserve_observations. Treasury change uses treasury_fair_value_usd, asset change uses reported_assets_usd, and cash, repo and token changes use cash_usd, repo_fair_value_usd and redeemable_tokens. Changes are current less prior stocks, with surplus change equal to asset change less redeemable-token change. This reported-stock basis is separate from the holdings-based reconstruction in qualified_coverage and treasury_valuation. Preserve any difference between reported and reconstructed values.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
